notes: A much faster preset library — same look, same animations, far less work for your computer.
added: The library's previews are now drawn once into small pictures in the background, instead of being re-drawn every time they move — opening, scrolling and comparing are much lighter
The library is prepared quietly after you open the panel, so it opens without a pause
Previews, your favourites row and the library itself no longer take memory in tabs where you never open PromptSnap
fixed: The library felt laggy: a full-screen blur was being redrawn 60 times a second while it was open
A card could flicker up and down under a resting mouse pointer
Every opening rebuilt all 105 cards from scratch
Memory kept growing after browsing the whole library (about 110 MB of pictures stayed loaded)

added: Preset library: browse every preset in a gallery, sorted into 9 categories (Enhance, Edit, Portrait, Product, Style, Social, Aviation, Story, Utility)
Every preset shows a before → after preview of what it does. Move your mouse across a preview to compare
59 new presets, including sky replacement, season and weather changes, headshots, passport-style photos, product packshots, food photos, 10 art styles, social formats and new aviation and story shots
Search by name, tag or description, in English or Khmer
Star your favourites. They also appear as one-tap thumbnails under the preset card
Recent shows what you used lately
My presets: save your own prompts. Words in {curly brackets} become fields, and you pick a preview picture
Duplicate & edit any preset to make your own version of it
The picked preset's preview flies into the panel, and its fields fade in
Keyboard friendly: type to search, use the arrow keys to move, Enter to choose, Esc to close. ← → on the preset card steps through presets
New suggestion chips for the new fields (sky, season, outfit, backdrop and more)
fixed: Choosing "Keep original" ratio left "aspect ratio Keep original" in most prompts
Picking no photo style could leave "Shot in —." in the prompt
Text-Safe Background offered aviation camera angles for the empty side; it now offers left, right, top…
Switching presets no longer highlights every word of the new prompt

added: Fresh, simpler design: calmer colours, clear labels, a brand header, and icon buttons for Reset and Copy
Selections glide: the aspect-ratio and settings highlights slide over to your new choice
The final prompt briefly highlights the words that just changed, so you can see where your pick landed
Buttons ripple where you press; Copy turns into a ✓ and Send's paper plane takes off
The panel opens with a gentle cascade, and new fields fade in when you switch presets
Much lighter on your computer: animations run on the graphics chip and idle work dropped sharply
fixed: Animation set to Off also switched off ChatGPT's own animations
An invisible strip next to the floating button blocked clicks on ChatGPT
Ctrl+Enter in ChatGPT's own message box added PromptSnap's prompt to your message and sent it
Copy could say "Copied" even when nothing was copied
A dragged panel could be left off-screen after making the window smaller
The Canva preview's loading shimmer kept using CPU with the section closed
Settings were saved on every single keystroke

added: Live progress card in the panel: ChatGPT's own stage ("Sketching it out"…), the %, elapsed time and time left
A dot picture on the card fills in as your image is made
Time left learns from your recent images, so it gets more accurate the more you use it
The browser tab's icon becomes a progress ring — watch it from any other tab; it turns into a ✓ when ready
The tab title shows the % and time left
Floating button: a glowing tip rides the ring, and the ring warms from amber to green as it nears done
Hover the floating button while the panel is closed to see the stage and time left
If ChatGPT pauses, the card says "still working…" and the ring breathes slowly instead of looking frozen
A ✓ draws itself on the button when the image is ready, and the card offers a View button to jump to it
fixed: Finished-image card and tab ✓ wait until you come back to the tab instead of disappearing unseen

added: Recognises ChatGPT's "Adding final touches" stage
fixed: Live % stopped showing on ChatGPT's newer image screen — PromptSnap now finds the chat wherever ChatGPT places it
The % wasn't read when ChatGPT draws the number and the % sign separately
The finished image wasn't detected, so there was no Image Ready and Send to Canva said "No generated image yet"
Other extensions' % labels on the page can never start the tracker by mistake

added: Animations run on the GPU, so they stay smooth while ChatGPT is busy generating
Settings, Suggestions and the update banner slide open and closed instead of jumping
Canva section opens and folds as one piece — Send to Canva no longer pops in and out
Progress ring sweeps smoothly and the % counts up between readings
Settings options glide a highlight to your new choice
Theme and panel-size changes ease across instead of flashing
Confetti flutters like paper, and Image Ready waits to play until you're back on the tab
Softer press feedback on buttons and chips, and a gentle focus glow on inputs
Smoother panel dragging that always keeps the panel on screen
fixed: Update Now, Later and × in the update window couldn't be clicked — an invisible layer covered them
Floating button's hover lift never showed
Sparks around the floating button jumped when you hovered it
Progress bar at the top of the panel was hidden behind the header
Update window and Image Ready screen vanished abruptly when closed
An empty Canva preview card showed when no design was open
Panel could be dragged off-screen and lost
Selected options in light theme showed grey text on green and were hard to read

added: Panel size setting (Small / Medium / Large) in the gear menu
Small is the new default — about 360px wide so it doesn't cover the chat
fixed: Panel took up almost the whole screen on laptops and scaled displays
"Insert into chat" button wrapped onto two lines

added: Canva section keeps its full preview; the settings above scroll when space is tight
Tighter spacing on shorter windows
fixed: Send to Canva and the bottom buttons could be cut off or overlap on shorter windows

added: Panel opens with a smooth animation that grows out of the floating button, and shrinks back when closed
Bigger, roomier panel with larger text, buttons and Canva preview
fixed: Send to Canva sometimes sent your input photo instead of the image ChatGPT generated

added: Switch between open Canva designs right in the panel
‹ › arrows to flip pages in your Canva design without leaving ChatGPT
Canva preview updates by itself when you edit, change page, or open/close a design
Bigger preview picture, plus a button to jump to that design in Canva
fixed: Clicking back to ChatGPT during a new job no longer fires the finish animation for the previous image
Your own uploaded image could trigger the "Image Ready" screen while ChatGPT was still generating
Canva section now stays collapsed until you open it
Canva preview showed the wrong page (the last one) instead of the page you're on
Canva preview froze until you pressed Refresh
‹ › page arrows didn't move Canva — they now switch pages even while Canva is in the background
Canva preview showed a blank placeholder (P18) for designs in a background tab

added: Update screen shows a single Installed pill when you're already current, instead of an arrow between two identical versions
Release notes are labelled "In this version" when up to date and "What's new" only when an update is waiting
Optional Earlier versions section listing past releases
fixed: Changelog was misleading — it showed the current release's notes as if they were an incoming update

added: Update downloads through Chrome automatically
Show the file button opens it in Explorer
fixed: Close button did nothing — a layout rule pinned the panel open
Canvas2D getImageData warning in the extension error list

added: Canva design preview with thumbnail, name and page number
fixed: Preview stayed black after an edit
Close button hit area

added: Collapsible Canva section
Live preview polling
fixed: Two copies of the image placed into Canva at once

added: Canva integration
Guardrail alerts
Animation settings
fixed: Panel loading blank on ChatGPT
